title: What If the Atlantic Overturning Circulation Shut Down?
description:
If the Atlantic's great current shut down, would Europe freeze, or would the real danger be speed?

Sources:
- NOAA: https://www.noaa.gov/science
- U.S. Geological Survey: https://www.usgs.gov/science
- NASA Science: https://science.nasa.gov/
- IPCC: https://www.ipcc.ch/reports/

Illustrative visuals are labelled. Speculative outcomes are not presented as measured fact.

Impossible Brief · Episode 25 · One impossible scenario, worked through with real science, every day.
